text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Thank you for today. See you<n>tomorrow, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After spending the day out with Super<n>Creek, I
suddenly recall that one day.

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
These first three years of the Twinkle<n>Series are
the most important to an<n>Umamusume, right?

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
That kind of complacent mindset<n>leaves no room for
an Umamusume<n>to grow.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My trainer is very considerate of me.<n>You don't
need to worry about us.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I decide to study hard to be as helpful<n>as possible
to Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
For the next two days, I study various<n>training
methods non-stop until...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list: What are you up to at this hour?
What are you up to at this hour?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm worried about you...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Lately, you've been up staying up<n>late to study,
right?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You'll get sick if you keep this up.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I love how hard-working you are, but<n>overexerting
yourself is a big no-no.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Training is something we should think<n>about and
work hard on together.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: There's no reason for you to struggle<n>on your own.
choice_data_list: I'm doing it for myself as well.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...In that case, I want you to take<n>today off. It's the
least you can do.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek is close to tears. I can't<n>make her
worry like this.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The moment I stand up to go home...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: ...Darkness envelops me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh! Are you awake now?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You collapsed.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's probably due to lack of sleep...<n>But whatever
the reason, you've<n>been pushing yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Have I... been worrying you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You've been pushing yourself too<n>hard with your
studies...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If being my trainer is putting too much<n>pressure on
you, then...
choice_data_list:
The only thing that's worrying me is my own
inability.

The only thing that's worrying me is my own
inability.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If being my trainer is putting too much<n>pressure on
you, then...
choice_data_list:
The only thing that's worrying me is my own
inability.

The only thing that's worrying me is my own
inability.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Thank goodness. Hearing you open<n>up like this
about it really makes me<n>feel relieved.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You are my one and only trainer. No<n>one can replace
you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The more you overextend yourself,<n>the more
worried I get.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: So please, don't make me worry so<n>much.
choice_data_list: I'll be more careful from now on.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Good. All right then, I'll sing you a<n>lullaby now.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Go to sleep. ♪ Go to sleep. ♪ Go to<n>sleep, little
trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek pats the futon in my<n>office with her
hand and puts me to<n>bed with a lullaby.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You've already worked plenty hard<n>for me. More
than plenty, in fact.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I don't care what anyone says. We<n>should keep
going at our own pace.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: And if that still makes you feel<n>anxious...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll spoil you silly until all those<n>cares melt
away!
choice_data_list: You already pamper me too much!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Not nearly enough! I know that for a<n>fact.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, do you need someone to hold<n>you while you
sleep? I'll shower you<n>with all the love I have! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I decline the offer and swear not to<n>push myself too
hard in the future...
